channel.title: Updates: Medicare "Level 2" Appeals [Records Request]
channel.description: Updates on the Data Liberation Project's Medicare "Level 2" Appeals request

item.title: Partial Records Published
item.author: The Data Liberation Project
item.description: On March 6, 2025, the Data Liberation Project published the partial records received while the appeal for full release was ongoing.

item.title: Request for Status Update Submitted
item.author: The Data Liberation Project
item.description: On February 9, 2025, the Data Liberation Project requested a status update for the appeal.

item.title: Appeal Filed
item.author: The Data Liberation Project
item.description: On November 27, 2024, co-requestors Mike Gartner and the Data Liberation Project filed a letter appealing the partial and full denials of the request, arguing that responsive records exist and were improperly withheld.

item.title: Partial Response Provided
item.author: The Data Liberation Project
item.description: On October 16, 2024, CMS responded to our request, providing four spreadsheets. The fields provided were more limited than what is in the publicly maintained data available for 2020 onwards. At the same time, CMS rejected in full the request for Part A and Part B appeal outcomes.
